decisions.reason: As an accessory that builds directly on the installed machine base, it requires limited new commitment, supports the core offer, and any weak uptake can still be read as temporary customer-specific demand variation rather than a reason to withdraw.

Although it is more distant from the established offer and therefore more at risk, it fits the firm's publicly stated move toward future-oriented production, digital workflows, and materials processing, which encourages management to persist a while longer.

A high-speed CNC milling machine line is highly visible, capital-intensive, and central to the firm's identity and announced direction, so sunk investment and public commitment strongly favor continuation.

The automatic tool change system is closely tied to the core machinery business, was presented prominently, and strengthens customer productivity, so management is inclined to retain it and attribute any disappointment to market timing rather than product failure.
